title.zh: 授权总检察长征收达沃省 Governor Generoso 市镇的 Matute 地产，作为该市镇镇址的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Solicitor General to Expropriate the Estate of Matute in the Municipality of Governor Generoso, Province of Davao, as Townsite of the Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Solicitor General to Expropriate the Estate of Matute in the Municipality of Governor Generoso, Province of Davao, as Townsite of the Said Municipality

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5905_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Solicitor General is hereby directed and authorized to expropriate, within six months from the approval of this Act, the Estate of Matute situated near the municipal building of the Municipality of Governor Generoso, Province of Davao Oriental, consisting of twenty hectares, more or less, and pay the price of the land with the taxes and licenses due to the Government from the said land. The land to be expropriated shall be used as a town-site of the said municipality: Provided, That such lands which are not needed for public use shall be subdivided by the municipality into lots to be sold at cost to the residents thereof on installment within a period of not than ten years.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 21, 1969.
